bugs.creator: kevinushey
bugs.summary: Should R export JAVA_HOME on startup?

comments.text:
This was originally filed at https://github.com/s-u/rJava/issues/298, where Simon indicated this may instead be a bug in R.

The core of the issue here is that, even after calling `sudo R CMD javareconf`, R does not export the `JAVA_HOME` environment variable to point at the version of Java it was configured to use (even though it is set in the R installation's `etc/ldpaths`). So, for example, one can have a situation like the following:

```
$ R --vanilla -s -e 'Sys.getenv("JAVA_HOME")'
[1] ""

$ head $(R RHOME)/etc/ldpaths
: ${JAVA_HOME=/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/jdk-17.0.1+12/Contents/Home}

$ /usr/libexec/java_home
/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/temurin-18.jdk/Contents/Home
```

In this case, even though R has been configured to use a specific JDK, rJava (and other packages that might consult `JAVA_HOME`) could end up using a different JDK since R did not set `JAVA_HOME`.

In short -- should R be exporting `JAVA_HOME` on startup, to point at the version of Java it's been configured to use?
